title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Two-map monumental Spaces + fixed frontal camera
preserve: mobile controls cannot trigger text-selection/copy UI

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v16 simplifies lighting around the user's stated rule: every sampled point is lit primarily by true 3D distance from the camera center, with only a secondary optical-axis weight. Nearby pillar bases are prevented from collapsing into black, while high/far tower sections fall much more aggressively toward near-black.

open_feedback: Review close-range pillars: approaching a column should make its nearby lower surfaces clearly brighter, not darker.
Review tower vertical gradient: tops should be substantially darker than bases and can become almost invisible.
Review both maps/floors: lighting should read as distance from the camera center rather than unrelated planar fades.
Preserve v15 arch-support continuity, backing walls, touch controls and non-selectable UI.
